name: burrow
description: A browser front door to your own machine for running Claude Code, sessions live on the server, any browser attaches.
comment: The root package exists to give Burrow ONE install, not to make it a workspace.
app/ and server/ stay independent packages with their own lockfiles because the
Dockerfile builds them in separate stages (app in the web stage, server in the
runtime stage) and never copies this file. Hoisting to a shared root node_modules
would break that split for no gain.
postinstall is what makes `npm install` do the whole job, install both halves,
build the frontend into server/web, then run the preflight checks. See scripts/setup.mjs.

scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix app run typecheck
